all.brief: Red-green leads Traditional Draft at 64.7%, ahead of white-blue at 64.2%. Craftwork Crusher tops the uncommons at 69.5% in hand. Being on the play matters less here: 63.0% against 62.3% on the draw.

top.brief: Top players do best in red-green at 70.7%, and its latest week reached 74.2%. Craftwork Crusher again leads the uncommons at 74.0% in hand. Blue-green is the weakest pair at 63.9%.

all.brief: White-blue is the best pair in Reality Fracture Premier Draft at 57.4%, rising to 59.0% by the latest week. Blue-black splashing G does even better at 58.1%. Craftwork Crusher is the standout uncommon at 62.1% in hand.

top.brief: Among top players, white-blue leads at 66.3%, with blue-red at 65.7%. Kiora of Fire and Ashes is the best uncommon at 69.7% in hand. Unsummon wins 67.2% yet goes at pick 6.9 on average.
